name: Document → RAG Ingestion
summary: Drop a document in a bucket; it becomes semantically searchable. Extract, chunk, embed, upsert to pgvector.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_ENDPOINT
env.description: S3-compatible Object Storage endpoint. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: Object Storage access key. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: Object Storage secret key. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
env.description: AI Gateway credential for embeddings. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: RAG_BUCKET
env.description: Bucket to watch for documents to ingest.

env.name: RAG_PREFIX
env.description: Key prefix within the bucket to watch. Storage triggers have no suffix filter, so non-documents under this prefix are recorded as skipped rather than failing.

env.name: RAG_EMBEDDING_MODEL
env.description: Embedding model. Changing this after ingestion requires a migration, not a config change: the vector column is fixed-width.

env.name: RAG_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS
env.description: Must match the model's output and the vector column width.

env.name: RAG_CHUNK_CHARS
env.description: Target chunk size in characters. ~1000 chars is ~250 tokens.

env.name: RAG_CHUNK_OVERLAP
env.description: Characters repeated across chunk boundaries so a fact spanning two chunks stays retrievable.

env.name: RAG_MAX_BYTES
env.description: Largest document to process. A hard cap is mandatory: the endpoint is public and functions run at a fixed size.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret for authenticating trigger delivery. Strongly recommended: Neon does not sign trigger POSTs.

triggers.description: Required by convention §5: storage triggers are Beta with no delivery guarantee and no delete events. Finds missed uploads and marks deleted objects.

operations.title: POST /ingest
operations.description: storage trigger — ingest one uploaded object

operations.title: POST /reconcile
operations.description: cron — find missed uploads, mark deletions, requeue stuck documents

operations.title: POST /search
operations.description: HTTP — vector search over ingested chunks
